  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/h2-2016-10-31.zip"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

cd "$unpackDir"

  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/r1pyq1zb401ggkbnc06k2dys4viwpvm4-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.0.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/release-1.2.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

  mkdir $out

mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/r1pyq1zb401ggkbnc06k2dys4viwpvm4-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.5.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mkdir $out
fi
mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
